whenToUse: Long lists that can be grouped by a criterion, such as contacts or records by date.
People check their position while scrolling.
Groups contain different numbers of items.
accessibility: Each group is a section with a heading, so people can move by heading.
Each group's list is named by its heading, so its size is read along with it.
The scroll area is a named region that takes focus and scrolls with the keyboard.
Sticky headers use only CSS position: sticky.
